method: All34actual V43 PDF entries rendered1.5x and viewed individually, six sequence contact sheets, five canonical identity sources, then final V44 cover exports inspected. Body exact carry verified separately. No subjective numeric score or child/owner acceptance inferred.
character_conclusion: Recognisable consistent core identities across book; no newly confirmed anatomy/costume contradiction. Eagle simplified talons are source-adaptation observation. Source finish/line-weight differences remain visible; generic scene regeneration is not justified.
layout_conclusion: Consistent two-treatment rhythm: full artwork and true-contour cutouts over blue stationery, common Sniglet/navy language. Some white-outlined captions feel busier; no new measured contrast failure claimed. Doublewide arrival is owner-directed; physical pagination/parity/gutter remain held.
scenery_conclusion: Two inherited continuity issues remain open: opening geography and fountain horn.
intentional_changes: cover promise ensemble is not literal simultaneous time

findings.issue: Original cover lacks matching left leaf and complete hinge structure. Prior scoped review missed this.
findings.repair: Two existing-scene architecture polygons, complete paired leaves/four hinges/two inner handles, original central Puff; title moved as one block to clear tip.

findings.issue: Ocean/island/palms through porthole versus forest/mountain Sky Lagoon arrival; surrounding geography changes.
findings.bounded_remedy: Reuse accepted Sky Lagoon source inside existing plane-window aperture only. Preserve Roshan, window frame, stained-glass castle identity, action and words. Not implemented in this cover repair.

findings.issue: Same seahorse fountain forehead changes from no projecting horn to large gold spiral cone to small gold nub.
findings.bounded_remedy: Establish canonical prop source from existing game/approved imagery, then harmonize forehead locally; preserve water/cup action. Not implemented in this cover repair.
